queries: Anthropic Meta Microsoft largest customers Suleyman June 2026 reduce spending
Mustafa Suleyman June 2026 Anthropic spending eliminate Verge
read_page: S-1; find: 25% of our revenue

sources_considered.why: Primary concentration disclosure establishes the period and top-five share, but does not identify these customers.
Accessible news coverage attributes the internal usage reductions to The Information.
Accessible June reporting quotes Suleyman’s stated goal and attributes the interview to Bloomberg.

evidence_items.locator: Risk Factors, customer and distribution-channel concentration

receipt.public_excerpt:
our top five

customers represented approximately 25% of our revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

evidence_items.explanation: Establishes the relevant concentration measure. It does not identify Meta or Microsoft as members of that group.

evidence_items.locator: Section: Meta and Microsoft reportedly cutting down on Claude usage

receipt.public_excerpt: Meta, too, was set to spend billions on internal AI usage before the company imposed token limits, spending controls and other monitoring.

evidence_items.explanation: The report describes Microsoft asking employees to limit Claude use and Meta reducing Claude Code users from approximately 60,000 to 30,000. It supports the reported internal-use component, not a top-five ranking or a decline across every distribution channel.

receipt.public_excerpt: “We pay a lot of money to Anthropic, so our goal is to reduce and ultimately eliminate that cost,” Suleyman said.

evidence_items.explanation: Confirms contemporaneous June reporting of the attributed goal. A stated goal does not establish that spending was subsequently eliminated.

unresolved_gaps: No accessible source establishes that both companies ranked among the five largest revenue customers for January–September 2026.
The usage coverage concerns internal employee activity and does not establish the direction of total revenue associated with Microsoft’s distribution channels.
The original The Information and Bloomberg reports could not be read directly.
